fetch_crypto_pair_price.description: Fetch the current price of a pair (e.g. BTC/USDT)

first_coin.description: The currency to fetch the price for (e.g. 'BTC' in 'BTC/USDT')

second_coin.description: The currency to fetch the price in (e.g. 'USDT' in 'BTC/USDT')

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the current spot price of a trading pair from the public Binance market data API by combining two coin symbols (e.g. first coin BTC + second coin USDT). Use to look up the live exchange rate of one crypto asset against another. No authentication required; the symbol must be a pair that exists on Binance or the request fails. Read-only lookup, idempotent.
